param_system_showdisplay_enabled_label: Activate display recording in debug logs
param_hardware_sensors_watertank_keep_he: Keep Heater On When Tank Empty
param_pid_enabled_help: Enables or disables the PID temperature controller
param_pid_ema_factor_help: Smoothing of input that is used for Tv (derivative component of PID). Smaller means less smoothing but also less delay, 0 means no filtering
param_pid_regular_kp_help: Proportional gain (in Watts/C°) for the main PID controller (in P-Tn-Tv form, <a href='http://testcon.info/EN_BspPID-Regler.html#strukturen' target='_blank'>Details<a>). The higher this value is, the higher is the output of the heater for a given temperature difference. E.g. 5°C difference will result in P*5 Watts of heater output.
param_pid_regular_tn_help: Integral time constant (in seconds) for the main PID controller (in P-Tn-Tv form, <a href='http://testcon.info/EN_BspPID-Regler.html#strukturen' target='_blank'>Details<a>). The larger this value is, the slower the integral part of the PID will increase (or decrease) if the process value remains above (or below) the setpoint in spite of proportional action. The smaller this value, the faster the integral term changes.
param_pid_regular_tv_help: Differential time constant (in seconds) for the main PID controller (in P-Tn-Tv form, <a href='http://testcon.info/EN_BspPID-Regler.html#strukturen' target='_blank'>Details<a>). This value determines how far the PID equation projects the current trend into the future. The higher the value, the greater the dampening. Select it carefully, it can cause oscillations if it is set too high or too low.
param_pid_regular_i_max_help: Internal integrator limit to prevent windup (in Watts). This will allow the integrator to only grow to the specified value. This should be approximally equal to the output needed to hold the temperature after the setpoint has been reached and is depending on machine type and whether the boiler is insulated or not.
param_pid_steam_kp_help: Proportional gain for the steaming mode (I or D are not used)
param_brew_setpoint_help: The temperature that the PID will attempt to reach and hold
param_brew_temp_offset_help: Optional offset that is added to the user-visible setpoint. Can be used to compensate sensor offsets and the average temperature loss between boiler and group so that the setpoint represents the approximate brew temperature.
param_steam_setpoint_help: The temperature that the PID will use for steam mode
param_brew_mode_help: Manual mode gives you full control over the brew time while Automatic mode allows you to activate brew-by-time and/or brew-by-weight. The brew will then stop at whatever target is reached first.
param_brew_by_time_enabled_help: Enables brew by time, so the pump stops automatically when the target brew time is reached. Only available when Brew Mode is set to Automatic
param_brew_by_time_target_time_help: Stop brew automatically after this amount of time
param_brew_by_weight_enabled_help: Enables brew by weight, so the pump stops automatically when the target weight is reached. Only available when Brew Mode is set to Automatic
param_brew_by_weight_target_weight_help: Brew is running until this weight has been measured
param_brew_pre_infusion_enabled_help: Enables pre-wetting of the coffee puck by turning on the pump for a configurable length of time.
param_brew_pre_infusion_time_help: Time in seconds the pump is running during the pre-infusion
param_brew_pre_infusion_pause_help: Pause to let the puck bloom after the initial pre-infusion while turning off the pump and leaving the 3-way valve open
param_backflush_cycles_help: Number of cycles of filling and flushing during a backflush
param_backflush_fill_time_help: Time in seconds the pump is running during one backflush cycle
param_backflush_flush_time_help: Time in seconds the selenoid valve stays open during one backflush cycle
param_maintenance_backflush_reminder_ena: Show a reminder on the display and web UI when the shot count since last backflush reaches the threshold. Counting continues when disabled.
param_maintenance_backflush_reminder_thr: Number of counted brews before a backflush reminder appears (default 50 ≈ monthly at 2 shots/day). Use lower values for water-only reminders.
param_TARE_ON_help: Tare the scale for zeroing before brewing.
param_hardware_sensors_scale_known_weigh: Weight in grams of the known calibration weight used for scale setup
param_hardware_sensors_scale_calibration: Primary scale calibration factor (adjust during calibration process)
Secondary scale calibration factor (for dual load cell setups)
param_pid_bd_enabled_help: Use separate PID parameters while brew is running
param_brew_pid_delay_help: Delay time in seconds during which the PID will be disabled once a brew is detected. This prevents too high brew temperatures with boiler machines like Rancilio Silvia. Set to 0 for thermoblock machines.
param_pid_bd_kp_help: Proportional gain (in Watts/°C) for the PID when brewing has been detected. Use this controller to either increase heating during the brew to counter temperature drop from fresh cold water in the boiler. Some machines, e.g. Rancilio Silvia, actually need to heat less or not at all during the brew because of high temperature stability.
param_pid_bd_tn_help: Integral time constant (in seconds) for the PID when brewing has been detected.
param_pid_bd_tv_help: Differential time constant (in seconds) for the PID when brewing has been detected.
param_STEAM_MODE_help: Toggle steam mode on or off.
param_BACKFLUSH_ON_help: Toggle backflush mode on or off.
param_VERSION_help: Firmware version (release tag or dev-<branch6>-<commit6> build).
param_standby_enabled_help: Turn heater off after standby time has elapsed.
param_standby_time_help: Time in minutes until the heater is turned off. Timer is reset by brew, manual flush, backflush and steam.
param_display_template_help: Set the display template, changes require a reboot
param_display_inverted_help: Set the display rotation, changes require a reboot
param_display_language_help: Set the language for the OLED display, changes requre a reboot
param_display_blinking_delta_help: Delta from setpoint for status LED and blinking temperature display
param_display_fullscreen_manual_flush_ti: Enable fullscreen overlay during manual flush
param_display_fullscreen_hot_water_timer: Enable fullscreen overlay during hot water mode
param_display_post_brew_timer_duration_h: time in s that brew timer will be shown after brew finished
param_display_heating_logo_help: full screen logo will be shown if temperature is 5°C below setpoint
param_display_pid_off_logo_help: full screen logo will be shown if pid is disabled

param_system_wifi_ssid_help: Name of your home WiFi network. Changes require a restart; the machine then joins it and the CleverCoffee-XXXX setup network closes.
param_system_wifi_password_help: Password of your home WiFi network. Changes require a restart.
param_system_offline_mode_help: Keeps the WiFi off the home network and opens the CleverCoffee-XXXX setup network only, changes require a restart.
param_system_hostname_help: Hostname of your machine, changes require a restart
param_system_ota_password_help: Password for over-the-air updates, changes require a restart
param_system_auth_enabled_help: Enables authentication for accessing certain parts of the website and for web requests in general. This setting secures the calls to sensitive url endpoints, e.g. for config parameters, hardware settings, factory reset, etc.
param_system_auth_username_help: Username for accessing the website and authenticating web requests.
param_system_auth_password_help: Password for accessing the website and authenticating web requests.
param_system_timing_debug_enabled_help: Log loop timing to the console. Sections: r=draw display buffer, D=display refresh, W=website, M=MQTT, H=hassio, T=temperature.
param_system_showdisplay_enabled_help: Enable or disable showing sendBuffer loops in debug logs
param_hardware_oled_enabled_help: Enable or disable the OLED display
param_hardware_oled_address_help: I2C address of the OLED display, should be 0x3C in most cases, if in doubt check the datasheet
param_hardware_relays_heater_trigger_typ: Relay trigger type for heater control
param_hardware_relays_valve_trigger_type: Relay trigger type for valve control
